statements.statement: DomainSpec v2 is the formal construction substrate for AlchLang rather than the Product Capability identity.
An AlchLang domain description must preserve ontology terms and typed edges together with rules, states, events, permissions, examples, open questions, and authority limits.
Model the world in which an agent may act instead of programming the agent directly.

recording_note: Captures owner direction from the current working session without converting pre-artifact approval into digest-bound adoption.
